Pushed successfully to `bb/relay-137-heartbeat-agent-tools-04-04-document-a-thr_e87cvek5j2`.

## Summary

Documents `agent-runtime`'s SOLID responsibility split as a compatibility boundary, closing issue #137:

- Added `backend/packages/agent-runtime/README.md`: an ownership map across pi-agent-core (single-run lifecycle/compaction), this package (session audit — `agent_runs`/`agent_run_events`, `unit`), `services/semprec-agents` (orchestration, not yet built), `services/semprec-ai-gateway` (egress/budget, not yet built), and `packages/module-registry` (tool allowlist); plus the explicit five-principle SOLID mapping (SRP/OCP/LSP/ISP/DIP) to the concrete files and types that express it.
- Added two `dependency-cruiser` rules scoped to `packages/agent-runtime`: internals reachable only through `src/index.ts`, and no direct import of `pi-agent-core`/`@anthropic-ai/*` from inside the package — both verified to actually fire against induced violations.
- Switched the shared depcruise config from `exclude: node_modules` to `doNotFollow: node_modules` so the provider-internals rule can see a direct edge without recursing into that package's own subgraph, and extended `check:boundaries` to scan `packages/` too.

Verified in this run: unit (83), integration (455, against an ephemeral Postgres), and e2e (5) test suites all pass; `check:boundaries` reports no violations; full workspace `tsc` build succeeds; working tree is clean post-push.
